events.name: FXQuoteRequested
events.trigger: PER-003 or PER-053 submits an FX trade enquiry in PH-059. SVC-007 creates FXTrade (ENT-040) with status = enquiry.

dealer_id.description: Staff.staff_id of the executing Treasury Dealer (PER-053)

currency_pair.description: ISO 4217 currency pair notation e.g. GBP/USD

sell_currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter code for the currency the client is selling

buy_currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter code for the currency the client is buying

requested_value_date.description: ISO 8601 requested value date (typically T+2 spot)

indicative_rate.description: Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate + indicative mark-up at time of enquiry
indicative_rate.derived_from: Bloomberg FXGO rate feed at PH-059 timestamp

enquired_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the enquiry

consumers.purpose: Internal audit log — SVC-007 publishes and subscribes to own topic for WORM audit pipeline compliance
Triggers enquiry acknowledgement notification to PER-003 treasury portal (informational — not a firm price)

events.ordering_guarantees: At-least-once delivery. Idempotent on trade_id — duplicate events safe due to enquiry-only status.

events.name: FXQuoteProvided
events.trigger: SVC-007 creates FXQuote (ENT-041) with status = quoted in PH-060. The firm 30-second quote is generated.

firm_rate.description: Legally binding all-in rate for this quote

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 UTC expiry of this firm quote (quoted_at + 30s)

interbank_reference_rate.description: Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at quote time for best execution evidence

quoted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when quote was generated

consumers.purpose: Delivers firm quote to PER-003 treasury portal with countdown timer display

events.name: FXTradeExecuted
events.trigger: PER-003 accepts the firm quote within the validity window in PH-061. FXTrade.status transitions to booked and FXQuote.status transitions to accepted.

executed_rate.description: All-in FX rate at which trade was booked

mifir_transaction_ref.description: UTI for FCA trade repository reporting

execution_venue.description: Execution venue identifier for MiFIR reporting e.g. XOFF (off-venue bilateral)

consumers.purpose: Internal: triggers confirmation generation (PH-062) and settlement queuing
Delivers trade execution notification to PER-003 with trade reference number

events.ordering_guarantees: Exactly-once delivery required. Idempotent on trade_id — duplicate processing must not result in duplicate booking.

events.name: FXTradeConfirmed
events.trigger: SVC-007 sets FXTrade.confirmation_sent = true and FXTrade.status = confirmed after SWIFT MT300 dispatch in PH-062.

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of confirmation dispatch
confirmed_at.derived_from: System timestamp when FXTrade.confirmation_sent set to true

swift_confirmation_type.derived_from: Determined by SVC-010 messaging capability for the counterparty

consumers.purpose: PH-062 [CROSS-CAPABILITY CAP-003]: Transmits SWIFT MT300 confirmation to the corporate client and counterparty correspondent bank. Consumes this event via SVC-102.
Delivers portal and email trade confirmation to PER-003 (COBS 16.3 compliance)

events.name: FXSettlementInitiated
events.trigger: SVC-007 creates FXSettlement (ENT-042) with settlement_status = initiated in PH-063 when value_date is reached and sanctions clearance is confirmed.

sell_amount.description: Amount to be debited from client sell-currency account

buy_amount.description: Amount to be credited to client buy-currency account

buy_leg_nostro.description: SWIFT BIC of the bank's buy-currency nostro account

sell_leg_nostro.description: SWIFT BIC of the bank's sell-currency nostro account

client_account_id.description: BusinessAccount.business_account_id for the buy-currency credit leg

consumers.purpose: PH-063 [CROSS-CAPABILITY CAP-003]: Executes nostro-to-nostro FX settlement on value_date. Constructs and transmits SWIFT MT300 settlement instruction / pacs.009 if CLS-eligible. Publishes EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) on success.

events.ordering_guarantees: Exactly-once delivery required. Idempotent on settlement_id. SVC-010 must not initiate duplicate settlement for the same settlement_id.

events.name: FXSettlementCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003) confirms nostro settlement on value_date. Published by SVC-010 and consumed by SVC-007 to update FXSettlement.settlement_status = settled.

settlement_status.description: Final status: settled | failed. SVC-007 uses this to transition FXSettlement.settlement_status.

swift_settlement_ref.derived_from: SVC-010 SWIFT messaging layer — SWIFT TRN assigned at transmission

settled_at.derived_from: Nostro account confirmation timestamp from SVC-010 correspondent connectivity

failure_reason.description: Conditional. Populated if settlement_status = failed. e.g. INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, CORRESPONDENT_REJECTED.
failure_reason.derived_from: SVC-010 error handling — SWIFT NACK or nostro rejection reason code

consumers.purpose: PH-063: Updates FXSettlement.settlement_status = settled (or failed), populates settled_at and swift_settlement_ref. Transitions FXTrade.status = settled. Records FX P&L mark.
Delivers settlement completion notification to PER-003 and PER-053

events.ordering_guarantees: At-least-once delivery. Idempotent on settlement_id — SVC-007 processes only first completion event per settlement_id.

events.name: FXCounterpartySanctionsScreened
events.trigger: SVC-007 publishes this cross-capability event immediately after trade booking (PH-061). Triggers real-time counterparty sanctions screening by SVC-051 (CAP-005) before settlement is released.

screening_request_id.description: Correlation ID for the sanctions screening request. System-generated by SVC-007.
screening_request_id.derived_from: System-generated by SVC-007 at EVT-089 publish time

client_legal_name.description: Legal name of the corporate client as held in BusinessCustomer.legal_name (SVC-005, fetched at PH-059)
client_legal_name.derived_from: BusinessCustomer.legal_name from SVC-005 (same-capability call at PH-059)

counterparty_currency_pair.description: Currency pair traded — country risk assessment input

buy_currency.description: Currency being received — country of currency jurisdiction risk

sell_amount.description: Trade notional for threshold-based screening rules

dealt_at.description: Trade execution timestamp for sanctions audit log

screening_reason.derived_from: Static value set by SVC-007 at publish

consumers.purpose: PH-061 [CROSS-CAPABILITY CAP-005]: Screens the corporate client counterparty against OFSI, OFAC, UN, and HM Treasury sanctions lists before settlement is released. If hit detected, publishes a hit-notification event consumed by SVC-007 to set FXSettlement.settlement_status = sanctions_hold. MLRO (PER-058) is notified. Idempotent on screening_request_id.
